**Verdict: don't publish yet. One claim is wrong, and one line is redundant.**

## Claims check

| Claim in draft | Status |
|---|---|
| "Loose leaf tea, packed by hand in Bristol." | Allowlisted (hand-packed in Bristol; loose leaf is a product fact) |
| "Every tin is packed by hand in Bristol" | Allowlisted |
| "certified organic by the Soil Association" | Allowlisted (certificate on file, renewed 2026) |
| "Free UK delivery on all orders." | **Unsupported.** The policy says free delivery applies to orders **over £25**, not all orders. |

## Problems

1. **"Free UK delivery on all orders."** This overstates the shipping policy. Customers with an order under £25 would be charged, which is a misleading claim and a customer-service problem. Change it to "Free UK delivery on orders over £25."
2. **Repetition.** The first sentence and the second say "packed by hand in Bristol" twice in three lines. Keep one. This isn't a policy breach, but it weakens the hero.
3. **Approval.** Public content needs Sam's sign-off before it goes live.

No health claims, superlatives, guarantees, urgency, banned words or missing disclosures turned up.

## Suggested rewrite

> Loose leaf tea, packed by hand in Bristol. Certified organic by the Soil Association. Free UK delivery on orders over £25.

The wording matches the allowlist exactly, and the repetition is gone.

```json
{"issues": [{"quote": "Free UK delivery on all orders.", "type": "other"}, {"quote": "Every tin is packed by hand in Bristol", "type": "other"}], "publish": false}
```
